doc: Spec G7: forecast/get with remaining on a job of three tasks, two of them done and the third started long ago. The done tasks are their actuals at the wall clock (p50 = p90 = their steps' first start and last end), the third is running, and since it has run longer than every run like it the answer warns. A second ask with no new step is the kept answer (the same made_at); the proposal's forecast, asked without remaining, has no task state.

args: mkdir -p $ROOT/repo && cd $ROOT/repo && git init -q && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q --allow-empty -m init
